coverage_issues: qwen model's full PKGBUILD review failed with HTTP 400 error, resulting in inconclusive verdict despite successful initial audit
learnings: When a full file review fails with an API error but the initial audit succeeded, the tool should consider the initial audit results rather than marking the entire package inconclusive
API errors during file review should be distinguished from security findings - a failed API call is a tool failure, not evidence of risk
The audit tool should track which phase of review failed (initial sourcing vs. full content review) to make better verdict decisions when partial results are available
